thread:
sophie: Quick kitchen check-in: I swung by the farmers market and left a small box of mini pastries on the island (12:10). Sticky note lists counts. Please take max one if others still around.
jamal: thanks sophie! which pastries are in there? any almond? trying to avoid cross-contam if possible.
ivy: theres an almond tart labelled on the sticky (1). also a cinnamon twist, two plain danishes, and a chocolate swirl.
oliver: small PSA: someone poured coffee grounds into the sink last night and the drain was sluggish this morning. please use the trash for grounds, compost bin under the sink for compostable filters.
kitchen-bot: Kitchen Ops reminder: label personal fridge items as "Name / Date / Keep?". Unlabeled perishables older than 96 hours will be cleared on Fridays. Coffee grounds should go in the compost bucket, not the sink.
sophie: thanks for catching that oliver. i left a tiny jar of apricot jam labelled "sophie 05/03 - share?" please respect labels.
jamal: poll idea: biweekly market drop (every other Wednesday) so we dont run out midweek. react :+1: for yes, :-1: for no, :shrug: if occasional.
ivy: :+1: biweekly sounds good. keeps variety and reduces single-person runs.
oliver: :shrug: i like surprises but willing to do the rota if needed.
kitchen-bot: Note: new compost bags are in the lower pantry. If you use the last box, please log it in the kitchen sheet and ping @facilities.
sophie: one small ask: if you label something KEEP, add a date. unlabeled "KEEP" items become office archeology.
jamal: i will venmo sophie for the pastries (jamal-food). also can pick up oat creamer on my next market run if folks want.
ivy: oat creamer please, thanks jamal.
oliver: thanks everyone. cleaned the grounds mess and left a note on the sink: "Please compost, not sink" :seedling:. pastries already diminishing.
sophie: closing note: please only take one pastry if people are still around and label personal fridge items. thanks and enjoy :)
